science.title: Fuel and sharpen your brain
science.text: Your brain is a hungry organ — it needs B-vitamins to build neurotransmitters and energy, antioxidants to protect neurons, and specific nootropics to support memory and focus. Brain & Focus Formula pairs a full multivitamin base with a 609 mg nootropic blend: bacopa and huperzine A for memory, phosphatidylserine and DHA for the neuron membranes that carry signals, and green tea, DMAE and GABA for calm, sustained focus. A foundation and an edge in two capsules.
